failure.message: Cannot assign to read only property 'equals' of object '[object Object]'
failure.cause: Foundry defines a read-only Array.prototype.equals; Cytoscape derives its collection prototype from Array.prototype and installs its own equals method with assignment.

resolution.policy: Define a writable own equals property on Cytoscape's collection prototype before its standard method mixins are installed.

verification.regression: Renderer imported and laid out a directed graph while Array.prototype.equals was read-only, then restored the original descriptor.

activation: This is a code-only update to an already enabled module. Reload the Foundry client with Ctrl+F5; no server restart is required.
